name: response_ir_chat_stream_opaque_anthropic
_comment: Regression for the pre-migration legacy stream bug: colon/space call IDs are opaque handles and must be preserved verbatim. The old Anthropic/Responses pair translators applied tool-name grammar to these IDs and returned pre-commit 502. The shared Chat source decoder and Anthropic event encoder now pass this contract without relaxing identity, argument, or lifecycle assertions.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-chat"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
